meta.name: The Serpent Queen
meta.description:
Considered an immigrant, common and plain, Catherine de Medici is married into the 16th century French court as an orphaned teenager expected to bring a fortune in dowry and produce many heirs, only to discover that her husband is in love with an older woman, her dowry is unpaid and she’s unable to concieve. Yet, only with her intelligence and determination, she manages to keep her marriage alive and masters the bloodsport that is the monarchy better than anyone else, ruling France for 50 years.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8 | S2 8/8

videos.title: Medici Bitch
videos.overview: Queen Catherine begins to tell the story of her life to Rahima, a servant girl, revealing how she came to enter the French Royal Court at the age of 14.

videos.title: To War Rather Than to Bed
videos.overview: Young Catherine begins to learn how to outwit the royal household in order to secure her future.

videos.title: The Price
videos.overview: Prince Henri returns from war with a new mistress, Filippa, and a baby. Catherine resorts to extreme measures to produce an heir.

videos.title: A New Era
videos.overview: Catherine has become a mother. King Francis suffers a fall from his horse while hunting with Henri and Catherine.

videos.title: The First Regency
videos.overview: King Henri departs to lead an army to defend France and places Catherine in charge as Regent, allowing her to test her powers further. Catherine asks Rahima to search Mary's room for a letter.

videos.title: The Last Joust
videos.overview: Catherine has a dream that predicts that her husband will be wounded while jousting. Catherine and Henri decide that their son Francis should delay his wedding to Mary.

videos.title: An Attack on the King
videos.overview: Mary visits Rahima and recounts her side of the story of life at the Royal Court. Catherine and Mary have conflicting views when it comes to freedom of religion in France.

videos.title: A Queen Is Made
videos.overview: The planned kidnapping of King Francis goes awry but Catherine devises a new plan to allow her control of the country.

videos.title: Grand Tour
videos.overview: Catherine aims to unite France under King Charles IX, pushing her agenda of a secular state; the Bourbons present an ambitious trade deal with Protestant England; as tensions rise on the Privy Council, the Guise's plan to reignite religious conflict.

videos.title: Second Coming
videos.overview: With peace balanced on a knife's edge, Catherine attempts to calm tensions by allowing the Bourbons to pursue the trade deal with England. Catherine halts the investigation into the Duke of Guise's arson involvement.

videos.title: Death of a Prince
videos.overview: News of Edith's miracle spreads throughout Europe; the Bourbon's leverage an opportunity for England to exploit France; Catherine must return urgently to France when Anjou's temper causes damage.

videos.title: Judas
videos.overview: Charles is ready to make his own rules, rejecting his mother's influence; with a rebellion on the rise, a mysterious plan is set, but when loyalty can be so easily swayed...miracles can happen.

videos.title: Time with the Family
videos.overview: Catherine relinquishes her seat on the Privy Council, but not before securing a place for Anjou; a religious war is on the horizon as Queen Elizabeth lands in the Netherlands; France's saving grace may be a marriage.

videos.title: Courting the Valois
videos.overview: Queen Elizabeth's arrival sparks manipulation and intrigue within the Valois Court; a dramatic fencing match for the Queen's affections ends in a shocking revelation, leaving the Court in turmoil.

videos.title: A House Divided
videos.overview: Tensions escalate as Edith and her followers wield newfound power while Catherine grapples with political manipulations and betrayals; as Queen Elizabeth's schemes unravel, Catherine must strategize to secure power and navigate a web of deceit.

videos.title: All Saints Day
videos.overview: Catherine's actions lead to chaos and bloodshed, leaving a trail of devastation in their wake; Catherine's desperate measures may prevent total war, or they could unleash forces beyond her control.

meta.slogan: It feels good to be bad.
